title: This month
description: Daily check for the month picked in the dropdown: income, each bucket's share of income against its target, and spending so far against the previous months.

list.name: month
list.label: Month
list.query: select to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(month_start, 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc
list.definition: select to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(month_start, 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc

list.name: income_base
list.label: Bucket shares of
list.description: What the bucket shares divide by. A complete month uses its actual income either way.
list.query: Expected income : expected,Income received so far : received

targets.rawSql:
select
  case
    when p.as_of_day = 0 then 'Not started'
    when p.is_complete_month then 'Complete month · shares are of the income received'
    else 'Day ' || p.as_of_day || ' of ' || p.days_in_month || ' · ' ||
      case
        when p.spendable_income_expected is null then 'no expected income yet (no full month before this one)'
        when p.spendable_income >= p.spendable_income_baseline then
          'income received is already above the ' || b.label || ', so it is the expected income'
        else 'income received: ' || round(p.income_received_share * 100) || '% of expected (the ' || b.label || ')'
      end
  end as status
from marts.fct_month_plan p
cross join lateral (
  select case p.baseline_months
    when 1 then 'previous full month'
    else 'mean of the previous ' || p.baseline_months || ' full months'
  end as label
) b
where p.month_start = '${month}'

panels.title: Income
panels.description: Received: money that reached chequing this month. Expected: an estimate for the whole month, the higher of income received so far and your average monthly income over the previous 3 full months; shown while it is above what you've received.

targets.rawSql:
select label, amount
from (
  select 1 as ord, 'received' as label, p.spendable_income as amount
  from marts.fct_month_plan p
  where p.month_start = '${month}'
  union all
  select 2, 'expected', p.spendable_income_expected
  from marts.fct_month_plan p
  where p.month_start = '${month}' and not p.is_complete_month
    and p.spendable_income_expected > p.spendable_income
) t
order by ord

defaults.noValue: No full month before this one

panels.title: Wants left
panels.description: Your remaining wants budget: your wants target share of expected income minus what you've spent on wants this month. Per remaining day counts today.

targets.rawSql:
select label, amount
from (
  select 1 as ord,
    'in total' as label,
    p.wants_plan - s.wants_spend as amount
  from marts.fct_month_plan p
  join marts.fct_monthly_summary s using (month_start)
  where month_start = '${month}'
  union all
  select 2, 'per remaining day',
    round((p.wants_plan - s.wants_spend) / (p.days_in_month - greatest(p.as_of_day, 1) + 1), 2)
  from marts.fct_month_plan p
  join marts.fct_monthly_summary s using (month_start)
  where month_start = '${month}' and not p.is_complete_month
) t
order by ord

panels.title: Needs left
panels.description: Your remaining needs budget: your needs target share of expected income minus your needs spending so far, including fixed bills.

targets.rawSql:
select
  case when p.is_complete_month then 'Needs left at month end' else 'Needs left' end as label,
  p.needs_plan - s.needs_spend as amount
from marts.fct_month_plan p
join marts.fct_monthly_summary s using (month_start)
where month_start = '${month}'

panels.title: Unallocated cash
panels.description: Income received this month minus what you've spent and what you've moved to savings or investments. Bills still due this month are not deducted.

targets.rawSql:
select case when p.is_complete_month then 'Unallocated at month end' else 'Unallocated so far' end as label,
  s.unallocated_cash as amount
from marts.fct_month_plan p
join marts.fct_monthly_summary s using (month_start)
where month_start = '${month}'

panels.title: Buckets vs targets
panels.description: Each bucket so far as a share of expected income, against its target. Switch 'Bucket shares of' at the top to use income received so far. Needs and wants targets are ceilings; the financial future target is a floor, due by month end.

targets.rawSql:
with p as (
  select * from marts.fct_month_plan where month_start = '${month}'
), s as (
  select * from marts.fct_monthly_summary where month_start = '${month}'
), i as (
  select nullif(case when '${income_base}' = 'received' then p.spendable_income
                     else p.spendable_income_expected end, 0) as income
  from p
), b as (
  select 1 as ord, 'Needs' as bucket, s.needs_spend as used, s.needs_target_pct as target from s
  union all
  select 2, 'Wants', s.wants_spend, s.wants_target_pct from s
  union all
  select 3, 'Financial future', s.financial_future, s.financial_future_target_pct from s
)
select
  b.bucket as "Bucket",
  b.used as "So far",
  round(b.used / i.income, 4) as "% of income",
  b.target as "Target",
  case
    when i.income is null then 'no income'
    when b.bucket = 'Financial future' then
      case
        when b.used / i.income >= b.target then '✓ target met'
        when p.is_complete_month then '▼ below target'
        else 'due by month end'
      end
    when b.used / i.income > b.target then '▲ over target'
    else '● within target'
  end as "Status"
from b
cross join p
cross join i
order by b.ord

panels.title: Wants by day
panels.description: Wants added up day by day; red where above the mean of the previous 3 full months by the same day. Dashed line: the month's wants target, which is the wants Target share in 'Buckets vs targets' times expected income.

targets.rawSql:
with d as (
  select date_day, month_start, amount_mtd, pace_mtd_avg_3m,
    coalesce(amount_mtd > pace_mtd_avg_3m, false) as above,
    coalesce(lead(amount_mtd > pace_mtd_avg_3m) over (order by date_day), false) as above_next
  from marts.fct_pace_day
  where month_start = '${month}' and series = 'wants'
)
select
  extract(day from d.date_day)::int as "Day",
  case when not d.above or not d.above_next then d.amount_mtd end as "This month",
  case when d.above or d.above_next then d.amount_mtd end as "This month, above the mean",
  d.pace_mtd_avg_3m as "Mean of previous 3 full months, by this day",
  p.wants_plan as "Wants target for the month"
from d
join marts.fct_month_plan p using (month_start)
order by 1

matcher.options: Mean of previous 3 full months, by this day

panels.title: Everyday needs by day
panels.description: Needs that are not recurring bills, added up day by day; red where above the mean of the previous 3 full months by the same day.

targets.rawSql:
with d as (
  select date_day, month_start, amount_mtd, pace_mtd_avg_3m,
    coalesce(amount_mtd > pace_mtd_avg_3m, false) as above,
    coalesce(lead(amount_mtd > pace_mtd_avg_3m) over (order by date_day), false) as above_next
  from marts.fct_pace_day
  where month_start = '${month}' and series = 'variable_needs'
)
select
  extract(day from d.date_day)::int as "Day",
  case when not d.above or not d.above_next then d.amount_mtd end as "This month",
  case when d.above or d.above_next then d.amount_mtd end as "This month, above the mean",
  d.pace_mtd_avg_3m as "Mean of previous 3 full months, by this day"
from d
order by 1

matcher.options: Mean of previous 3 full months, by this day

panels.title: Where wants went this month
panels.description: Wants by category. A category is listed when it has spend this month or in at least 2 of the previous 3 full months, so a one-off does not show up as usual.

targets.rawSql:
with cur as (
  select category_name, sum(spend) as spend,
    sum(spend_to_date_avg_3m) as to_date, sum(spend_avg_3m) as whole
  from marts.fct_subcategory_month
  where month_start = '${month}' and bucket = 'wants'
  group by category_name
), base as (
  select s.category_name, count(distinct s.month_start) as months_with_spend
  from marts.fct_subcategory_month s
  join marts.fct_month_plan p using (month_start)
  where s.bucket = 'wants' and s.spend > 0 and p.is_complete_month
    and s.month_start >= ('${month}'::date - interval '3 months')
    and s.month_start < '${month}'::date
  group by s.category_name
)
select
  c.category_name as category,
  c.spend as "This month so far",
  c.to_date as "Mean of previous 3 full months, by this day",
  c.whole as "Mean of previous 3 full months, whole month"
from cur c
left join base b using (category_name)
where c.spend > 0 or coalesce(b.months_with_spend, 0) >= 2
order by 2 desc, 4 desc nulls last, 1

matcher.options: Mean of previous 3 full months, by this day
Mean of previous 3 full months, whole month
